Photometry Encoding Across Five Conditions

Time-resolved GLM (default and expanded formulas) and FIR deconvolution, run independently for each of five FP1/FP2 conditions: two drug states (none, DCZ) across two cohorts, plus the FP1-retrained follow-up cohort.

5 conditions 121 total sessions 2 GLM formulas per condition 1 FIR fit per condition

Each condition below was fit independently: a default formula (matching the original FP1/FP2 pipeline — choice, reward, reward history, |ΔQ|, behavioral state), an expanded formula adding signed reward-prediction error, a model-implied belief signal, and explicit switch-dynamics regressors, and an FIR deconvolution kernel fit per reward-history channel. See the cross-condition comparison report for direct overlays between conditions.

Notes. WCL28's two contaminated FP1-retrained sessions (9/11/23, 9/13/23) are excluded throughout. FP1-none's 8 mislabeled DCZ/saline sessions (present in that cohort's QC report but correctly absent from its master session list) are excluded from every analysis here — an early version of the FIR run for this condition briefly included them and was corrected before this report was built. All figures are freshly generated from this session's pipeline; no existing FP1/FP2/WCL report or output was modified.
